description: This file contains unit tests for the SubscriptionEventAdapter class within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter project. It tests conversion between SubscriptionEvent objects and Adaptable representations, ensuring correct serialization and deserialization of various subscription-related events.

classes.name: UnknownSubscriptionEvent
classes.description: A mock implementation of SubscriptionEvent used for testing unknown event types, returning a generic event type 'thing-search.subscription:foobar'.
